audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Proposition 3.4, final display on page 35; Equation (4.13), page 40; Theorem 5, (3.4) and footnote 3, page 24
limitations: Counterevidence: No entropy of these metrics is computed. A sharper tame Taylor remainder could rescue fixed-topology stability; qualitative Theorem1 only specifies some sufficiently large N.

Counterevidence: Printed compact p formula4.2 is correct and an initial proposed reversal was rejected. Double twisted derivative sign is unchanged. Final95n-198 arithmetic is correct conditional on its input. No counterexample to4.10,4.5 or final rigidity is asserted.
Counterevidence: The preceding covariant-Hessian contraction is intrinsic and offers a repair. No different-variance or falsecorrected-Hessian claim; no counterexample to real/complexmainrigidity.

Counterevidence: Removing factorial reconciles later conventions, realenergy stayspositive, degree2negative-curvature gauge hasnoKilling1forms. Correct normalizedfibermoments recoverreal/complexmeanvolumeestimate.

Counterevidence: Explicit correctedprojectedsymbol provesinjectivity; octonioniccurvaturebound suppliesanalogousrepair. Principal quaternionic symbol doesnot depend on frame derivatives, despiteP3lowerorderdefect.
Counterevidence: Bothconstantrepresentatives havezerovariance, so testdoesnotrefuteHessianquadraticidentity. Repairedparallelpairing stillgivesmeanbound; real/complexformulaunaffected.
